body:
Triage: **`needs-user-decision`** (kept `domain:devx`, applied by os-help 02:26Z — landing agrees: the fix is prose in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s 发版板 section plus possibly a seat-duty change, general agent tooling per the #5469 criterion).

Why the decision box: the three options fork on a question only the maintainer can answer — **is a v17 obligation whose fix lives in cloud release-blocking or advisory?** (Option A adds a third board query and gives the cloud seat `target:*` production duty; B strips the label at migration; C keeps two queries and adds a freshness backstop.) The card's own recommendation (A, with C as backstop regardless) is reasonable but changes the board contract that #6903/#6906 set — maintainer territory.

**Premise check** (`origin/main` @ `8dd98bf`, cloud @ `1cb29f5`): both quoted SKILL halves live — 「cloud **按本节规则永不带这个标签**,所以那里出现命中本身就是误标信号」 and rule 1 Exception A's recreate-at-destination instruction. The measured instance checks out: cloud#1222 is open carrying `pm:queue` + `target:v17` (the state the 发版板 section declares impossible), migrated from #5852 under #7167. The contradiction is real and currently live on the board — until ruled, anyone running the prescribed two-query board read misses cloud#1222.

**Dup check:** no open card covers the 发版板/file-at-destination seam (the card's own nine-result dedup sweep is corroborated; #6903 and #6906 are both closed and predate #7165). #7492 (same author, one minute earlier) amends a different section — kept separate.

Not `target:v17` itself — process card. ⚠️ But it **guards** the v17 board's integrity while cloud#1222 sits outside both prescribed queries, so it is cheap and load-bearing to rule early; flagged in this round's brief.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Maintainer ruling recorded 2026-08-11 (PM session, executing the maintainer's direct instruction in chat — verbatim: 「接受你的全部建议，请更新 issue 的状态和标签」, accepting the four-lens decision-inbox review in full).

**Ruling: accepted.** The release board becomes **three queries** (objectstack + objectui + cloud); the `repo:cloud` whole-repo seat gains `target:*` production for its own backlog under the same one-producer-per-backlog discipline; the "a hit in cloud is a mislabel signal" clause is repealed — it was instructing readers to destroy the only evidence of a real blocker (measured: cloud#1222 invisible to both prescribed queries for ~10h).

Priority note: this is the most urgent of the SKILL batch — the board is lying about the v17 frontier until it lands. cloud#1222's `target:v17` stays exactly where it is.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:devx` seat, consolidated SKILL batch, `model: claude-fable-5`).
